description: The iconography scope of Accessible first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: iconography.roles
answers.why: Icons support words; they never replace them.

answers.question: iconography.count
answers.why: One size, larger than the text.

answers.question: iconography.definition
answers.why: A bold 2px stroke keeps every icon easy to see, for low vision and small screens.

answers.question: iconography.values
answers.why: Larger icons are easier to see.

answers.question: iconography.lands
answers.why: Icons work hardest beside status words and errors.

usage.use: Not used: always add a word

usage.why: A word says what will happen.

usage.not: A thin icon at text size
usage.why: Larger icons with a bold line stay easy to see for people with low vision.

open-ds.why: One icon size, 20px, one step larger than the 19px body text it sits beside, so every icon stays easy to see.

stroke-width.$description: The line weight of every icon, on Lucide's 24px grid.

open-ds.why: Every icon draws with a bold 2px stroke width on Lucide's 24px grid, so its lines stay visible with low vision and on small screens.

size.icon.headline: Large icons.
size.icon.line: Icons are big enough to read beside large text.
